verdict.rationale: CIPO is a government IP office that publishes databases and bulk data, so offering official developer SDKs is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only web online services, MyCIPO account portals, database search and downloadable bulk data. No official SDK or client library is documented, and bulk-data downloads are a different capability that does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
